name: Secure University Remote Access Management System
description: Design a secure university remote access management system that controls off-campus access to internal university applications, servers, research systems, and administrative resources. Authorized administrators should be able to define remote-access permissions, approve or revoke access for users, review active remote sessions, and terminate suspicious sessions. The system should authenticate users before access is granted, enforce role-based access restrictions, detect repeated failed login attempts and unauthorized access attempts, generate security alerts, and maintain audit logs of remote access activity and administrator actions. The platform should provide a centralized dashboard, integrate with existing university identity services, support multiple campus locations, and remain secure, reliable, scalable, and manageable.
